steps.note: K1.1 states the net target change (JV+RG)x independent of the initial scratch values a,c, and K1's method and motivation give the reason (first rows remove old scratch values, last rows restore them, cancel by linearity).

K1.2 states the bit-case central coefficient |S cap T| mod 2 and that the side injection cancels exactly the intersection-one cases; the self coefficient one follows from that formula (3 mod 2) and K1.3's net map y<-y+x.
The plan never gives the complex-case central coefficient (|S cap T|-1)/2 or the cancellation of intersections zero and two; K1.3 only asserts the resulting net map y<-y+x for both constructions.
K1.4 gives the three stages (x,y)->(x,y+x)->(-y,y+x)->(-y,x), and K1 states that every scratch wire is restored.
The plan has no per-edge orthogonal residuals or their dimensions; K3's method and K3.3 only say labels are nested and dimension changes are counted.
K3.3 says neighbouring triple lines are orthogonal, but the plan never treats the side edge 2->5, the inclusion <t_X> in t_Y^perp, or the complement <t_X,t_Y>^perp of dimension h-2.
K3.4-K3.7 state that the only decreasing edges are central 3->4, each losing h (L=Ich); sources sum to N and sinks to Wm-N, so the signed sum is Wm-2N and the absolute sum is Wm-2N+2L.

KB.1c uses an orthonormal basis of each residual, but the plan never argues that nonzero residuals over F_2 are nondegenerate and nonalternating, so the basis's existence and the absorption of alternating planes are missing.
K3.8 states L_b/N=100/539 and L_c/N=101/539.
The plan never states that weight is additive mod 4 for orthogonal binary vectors or the formula q_V-q_U=sum wt(v)[v.x]; it goes straight to the product of kernels.

KB.1a and KB.1c assert the kernel C=aI+bX and the product of (aI+bX_{v_j})^{eps_j}, but the odd weight, the phase i^{eps[v.x]} and the H diag(1,-1) H = X conversion to a translation kernel are not stated.

KB.1c gives one kernel per residual basis vector, KB.1e makes each kernel one child acting on all f columns of a slot (C^{otimes f}), and KB.1g counts exactly s_c such factors, which matches the paper's per-column tensoring.

K3.11 asserts only that telescoping gives C^{otimes m} on every role; the plan omits the zero and full label frames, the C^{-1} on the 27 coordinates of supp(u_a), the Z_{a,k} and i^{27k} repair, and the negation of the X outputs.
K3.8 gives both loss ratios below 1/2, and K3.10 and K3.12 give the positive deficits (N-2L_b, 2N-2L_c) and s<Wm.
The exact value eta_b=339/22587335000000 never appears; K3.14 only says the deficits exceed 20*2^-50.
The exact value eta_c=73/19906842167500 never appears in the plan.
K3.13-K3.15 state tau=sigma=1-2^-50, both deficits above 20*2^-50, log m<20, hence m^{1-2^-50}>m(1-eta) and s/W<m^tau.
K4.1 states the factorization A=E_1 Pi E_2 with exactly a ones, but not the elimination proof (topmost nonzero row's rightmost pivot, lower-triangular clearing, repeating on the active indices).
The plan works over Z/q^b but never mentions choosing a fixed odd prime that avoids every denominator so the rational factorizations specialize with invertible triangular factors.

K4.2 asserts the triangular parts cost O(V), and K4's motivation paraphrases the 'linear-time direction' sentence, but the plan never states the descending-order coordinate update that keeps the earlier controls at their original values.
K4.3 gives D_j<-D_j+H_i, swap, D_j<-H_i-D_j for each one of Pi, and K4.4 gives one interchange per one, a in all.
Only C_0 d^{C_1} (KB.4c) and C_1=20 (PR.4) appear; the definitions of E, B, nu, C_1=max{20,nu+3} and C_0=128mB^2 are missing.
The plan has only the time recurrence F(e); the arithmetic-depth recurrence A(e)<=sA(e/m)+E with leaf bound 8e is absent.
The unrolling B^{k+1}<=B^2 d^nu, A(e)<=8B^2 d^{nu+1} and the total below C_0 d^{C_1} are not in the plan.

KB.4c states the p+ceil(C_0 d^{C_1}) fractional bits and o(p) from eps C_1<1, but omits the depth-l induction (values in 2^{-(p+l)}Z[i] of modulus at most 2^l) and the Delta+3 integer bits that make the guard exact.
KB.4d states that every row of H has absolute row sum one, so disks are preserved and the final truncation errs by less than sqrt2 2^-p.

summary: P06 states 10 of 26 sub-steps. It is strong on the counting and conclusions: the bank-exchange net map and its stages (B1, B2, B4), the telescoped dimension count and loss ratios (L3, L5, R1), the exponent bound (R4), the per-one shear (M4), the kernel-per-residual-vector count (P3), and the row-sum truncation bound (S5). It asserts but does not derive the complex coefficient, the residual table and orthonormal bases, the weight-additivity phase mechanism and endpoint repair, the exact eta values, the elimination proof, the choice of prime, the triangular update order, and the whole depth and guard-bit analysis (S1-S4).
